openclaw-chat v1.0.3

- Added features: Local port & app status management for real-time monitoring and control.
- Introduced self-healing emergency recovery, allowing the main agent to auto-repair system failures.
- Updated documentation in SKILL.md to reflect these new capabilities.

- Updated bundled asset filenames for improved cache management.

- No functional or code changes.

Initial release of openclaw-chat.

- Native chat UI designed for OpenClaw mobile use.
- Supports group discussions and collaboration between multiple Agents.
- Automatic memory sync for Agents (local and remote).
- Remote management interface for local services via mobile.
- Android APK available for direct installation; iOS version pending review.
- Key features: 1-on-1 chat, Agent list, group management, service management, cron job scheduling, real-time logs, bilingual UI, and PWA support.
